articles.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-5 Turbo with Native Multimodal Reasoning Across Code, Video, and Audio
articles.summary: OpenAI released GPT-5 Turbo, featuring deeply integrated multimodal reasoning that can jointly process video streams, audio, and codebases in a single context window. Benchmarks show a 38% improvement over GPT-5 on complex software engineering tasks and a step-change in temporal video understanding, raising the bar for agentic coding and media analysis workflows.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini Ultra 2 Achieves New State-of-the-Art on Mathematical Olympiad Problems
articles.summary: DeepMind announced Gemini Ultra 2, which scored 92% on the IMO 2026 problem set using a novel chain-of-thought search architecture combined with formal verification. The system integrates a learned proof assistant that can backtrack and explore alternative solution strategies, marking a significant advance in AI-driven mathematical reasoning.

articles.title: Tesla Optimus Gen 3 Begins Limited Deployment in Third-Party Warehouses
articles.summary: Tesla confirmed that its Optimus Gen 3 humanoid robot has begun pilot deployments at Amazon and DHL fulfillment centers, performing bin picking, shelf stocking, and package sorting tasks. The updated hardware features 28 degrees of freedom in each hand and a new vision-language-action model that enables zero-shot adaptation to novel objects without facility-specific retraining.

articles.title: Boston Dynamics and Hyundai Unveil Atlas Commercial Platform with Dexterous Manipulation
articles.summary: Boston Dynamics officially launched the commercial Atlas platform, backed by Hyundai's manufacturing scale, targeting automotive and heavy industry applications. The electric humanoid robot demonstrates reliable bimanual manipulation of irregular objects up to 25 kg and ships with a ROS 2-based SDK and a sim-to-real transfer pipeline for custom task programming.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces 'Constitutional Classifiers' to Defend Against Jailbreaks at Scale
articles.summary: Anthropic published a paper and deployed a new safety layer called Constitutional Classifiers, which trains lightweight adversarial detector models using constitutionally generated attack examples. Internal red-team evaluations show jailbreak success rates dropping below 1% on Claude 4 while maintaining less than 0.5% false positive rates on benign queries, offering a scalable approach to LLM safety.

articles.title: TSMC Begins Volume Production of 1.4nm Process Node Ahead of Schedule
articles.summary: TSMC announced it has entered volume production on its N1.4 (1.4nm-class) process node, approximately one quarter ahead of its original roadmap. Early yields are reportedly above 70%, and the node delivers an 18% speed improvement and 22% power reduction over N2, with Apple, Nvidia, and AMD expected among the first customers ramping designs in early 2027.

articles.title: Microsoft and Quantinuum Demonstrate Fault-Tolerant Logical Qubit Operations Below Error Threshold
articles.summary: Microsoft and Quantinuum jointly demonstrated sustained fault-tolerant operations on 12 logical qubits with error rates consistently below the theoretical threshold for surface codes, using Quantinuum's latest trapped-ion system. This milestone brings practical quantum error correction closer to reality and lays the groundwork for running commercially relevant quantum algorithms within the next two to three years.

articles.title: Figure AI Raises $1.5B Series C to Scale Humanoid Robot Manufacturing
articles.summary: Figure AI closed a $1.5 billion Series C round at a $15 billion valuation, led by Bezos Expeditions and Microsoft, to build a dedicated humanoid robot factory in South Carolina. The company plans to produce 10,000 Figure 03 units annually by late 2027, each powered by an on-device vision-language-action model capable of learning new manipulation tasks from under ten demonstrations.
